# QUAICU

> QUAICU Solutions Private Limited builds governed software for accountable business, from Hyderabad, India. Work is delivered with an AI engine, a named person reviews and approves every change, and every action is recorded. Supported by Google for Startups and T-Hub; member of NVIDIA Inception and NASSCOM's 2026 DeepTech cohort.

## Core pages
- [How it works](https://quaicu.org/how-it-works): the AI engine, human review and the delivery model
- [Trust](https://quaicu.org/trust): how every delivery stays checked, and the list of sub-processors
- [Proof](https://quaicu.org/proof): the reusable governance foundation behind every engagement
- [Managed software support](https://quaicu.org/support): support priced per ticket
- [Governed platform delivery](https://quaicu.org/builds): new platforms designed, built and launched with the client
- [How we work](https://quaicu.org/how-we-work): talk, scope, deliver, support
